description: This file contains unit tests for the DirectoryMembershipSnapshot functionality within the Orleans distributed runtime, focusing on range ownership, non-intersecting ranges, and ring coverage validation.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshotTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying directory membership snapshot functionality, including range ownership, range intersections, and ring coverage.

methods.name: GetOwnerTest
methods.description: Tests that the snapshot can retrieve an owner for a given hash when the cluster has at least one member.

methods.name: MembersDoNotIntersectTest
methods.description: Validates that member ranges within the snapshot do not overlap/intersect.

methods.name: ViewCoversRingTest
methods.description: Checks that the union of all member ranges precisely covers the entire ring.

methods.name: MemberRangesCoverRingTest
methods.description: Ensures that the ranges assigned to members collectively span the whole ring without gaps.
